City of Encinitas
Youth Commission
AGENDA

04:30 PM

Youth Commission Chair and Vice-Chair
The Youth Commission elects the FY23-24 Chair and Vice Chair to serve a one-year term.

The Youth Commission will review a list of potential work plan initiatives and begin work on the plan and assignment of Youth Commission representatives (maximum of (3) commissioners per initiative).
